0022600105.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-1, ninth in the East) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (0-1, 12th in the East) in a game that comes after one game for each team. Brooklyn has yet to play on the road this season and is missing Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder injury. The Nets lost all three meetings with Cleveland in 2025-26, most recently a 106-102 defeat in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
